fix(claude): preserve terminal failure and per-invocation prompt ownership

LynCo-Patches: F26-native-env, F27-native-files, F28
Source: 795f80012036d4ed53533cf2378d2c20195a2b8f; explicit node:process import agrees with the published FUSI-017 WIP correction.

Emit the existing pi AssistantMessage error contract instead of disguising provider failure as ordinary text. Await process close rather than accepting stdout EOF as a successful exit. Preserve actual result-only text and bounded cancellation settlement. Reject an already-aborted call before spawning.

Native Claude children get child-local authentication filtering; API credentials in the parent remain unchanged. Prompt files use exclusive random names, owner-specific cleanup and mode 0600. Use the documented append-system-prompt-file CLI flag. No new scheduler, global auth mutation or temporary-file registry service.

Validation: upstream terminal-contract regression 17 failed/1 passed. Final entire adapter package:376 tests pass; package TypeScript check passes on Linux/Node22.16.0. Process boundary is fake for provider tests; real pi event stream and Agent consume it. Native provider login/model requests and Windows launch not exercised.

Delete-when: upstream reports terminal errors/abort truthfully, waits for actual exit, prevents already-cancelled spawn and isolates concurrent prompt/auth state through the supported adapter boundary.
